summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: UK banks blocked from cyber AI tool Mythos get offer from rival OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Critical Windows Netlogon RCE flaw now exploited in attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 31 articles published in the last 24 hours
